}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== The CPU is an.. :'''[[Infineon]]''' PSB7200ZDW (rebranded '''TI''' TNETD7200ZDW) The wireless MAC/BB is an.. :'''[[Infineon]]''' PSB1350AZGU (rebranded '''TI''' TNETW1350A) The wireless RF chip is an.. :'''[[Infineon]]''' PSB3422 (rebranded '''TI''' TNETW3422)
The default SSID is '''qwestXXXX''' where '''XXXX''' is the last 4 digits of the serial number.
The power adapter included with the device appears to be a '''Leader Electronics''' :P/N 5670806-00-01 Model No: MT20-21120-A03F (12V, 750mA).
